text:
Aapke order (ORD-22006, Crockery set) ka status abhi "in_transit" dikha raha hai, yaani woh raste mein hai aur deliver hona baaki hai. 

Kya aapne ise kisi aur order ID ke baare mein baat ki thi, ya fir yeh wahi order hai? Main iski delivery tracking bhi check kar sakta hoon agar aap chahein.
